published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Holy priest casting Smite, on its own gear with no hit. It keeps Shadow Word: Pain up for Power in Light. Smite's high mana cost holds it back.
rotation: Pre-pull: Smite at -2s to land at the pull, then the on-use trinket at -0.1s
Dark Sacrifice (Undead) below 40% mana. Power Infusion, racials and trinkets on cooldown.
Shadow Word: Pain when it is down, with 9s or more left, to keep Power in Light up
Devouring Plague when it is down, with 12s or more left and 80% mana or more
Shadow Word: Death when a Smite would not land before the fight ends
Inner Focus on cooldown, for the next Smite
Rank 8 Smite while mana lasts the fight at 35 mana a second
Wand from 10% to 20% mana with 60s or more left, or when nothing else can be cast
consumes: Elixir of Holy Power (Elixir of Greater Firepower)
caveats: Short on mana, so DPS falls in longer fights (786.1 / 765.7 / 689.7 at 120s / 180s / 300s). Devouring Plague (24s cooldown) is cast only above 80% mana.
Smite VIII's base damage is ×1.09 the client's value.
Forever's downrank penalty is in the sim, so the cheaper Smite is rank 7.
Penance and Mind Blast would lose DPS, so it skips them. Shadow Word: Death is cast only at the end of the fight.
Only the Vestments of Conviction 2-piece is active. The 4-piece and 5-piece would add 4.7 DPS.
Left out: Kreeg's Stout Beatdown and Elixir of Sages (+6.4).
Dark Sacrifice gives 1600 mana plus Spirit, as its tooltip says. Client data says just 1600.
No Holy Fire, because its mana does more on Smite. Keeping it up would be -21.8 / -10.6 / +9.5 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.

Race spells: the Undead's Dark Sacrifice adds 28.9 DPS, the most of any racial here, because Smite is short on mana. Night Elf Starshards would cost 17 DPS: its 6s channel deals about 480 DPS against Smite's 700, and the mana it saves doesn't make that up. Dwarf Chastise works only on Humanoids, and there it costs 8.5 DPS: a Smite does more with the global cooldown. Troll Shadowguard can only be cast in Shadowform.
notes: mksettings request plus ConsumesSmite from presets.ts: defaultPotion MajorManaPotion, firePowerBuff ElixirOfGreaterFirepower, manaRegenElixir GreaterMagebloodElixir, spiritElixir ElixirOfGreaterSpirit, fillerExplosive ExplosiveGoblinLandMine (added 2026-10-23, standards 11: -1.6 / +0.4 / +2.7 at 120 / 180 / 300 sec). Gear level60_phase1_smite, apl level60_smite. Regenerated 2026-10-23 from mksettings (natural flask zone on) and the ui APLs, which tools/rotopt/priest_presets.sh writes from the templates. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD.
